author: Jessica Hische, interviewed by Lenny Rachitsky
basis: Professional creative account and a proposed noticing exercise
reported_outcomes: Reports selecting emotions from AI-generated lists for a children’s book and retaining production work she finds fulfilling; rejected one AI image experiment.
proposed_outcomes: Articulate visual preferences; use a generated pool without surrendering selection or making.
limits: Personal associations are not universal audience responses.
The noticing exercise and AI word-list workflow are separate practices, not a tested combined sequence.
No measured improvement in taste or originality.
review_note: Retain two distinct cards: observing one’s visual reactions and selecting from a generated creative pool.
coverage: Close-read complete relevant transcript exchanges at listed timestamps and surrounding context; not full 488-line transcript; audio/video not reviewed.
